newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Honko seen issuing 67 mln shrs in IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Honko seen issuing 67 mln shrs in IPO - sources.

text.p: Electronic components maker and distributor Honko International Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 67 million new shares, with one warrant attached for every five shares, at a price ranging HK$0.98 to HK$1.01 per share, market sources said on Wednesday.
Honko will have a historic price to earnings multiple of 6.1 to 6.3 times, the sources said. Net proceed is expected to be used for expansion of the company's production facilities.
Honko's initial public offering of shares is expected to open from October 1 to 4 and dealing in shares is expected to begin on October 14, sources said.
The company's turnover increased to HK$807.6 million for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, up from HK$533 million in 1995 and HK$367.4 million in 1994.
Its net profit was at HK$43 million for 1996, up from HK$33 million in 1995 and HK$20 million in 1994, sources said.
Standard Chartered is the sponsor of the new issue and HSBC Investment is the principal underwriter, they added.
